{"reason":"Replace the forecast condition with market-signal-mismatch OR forecast-bias above 0.05, lowering v1’s 0.1 threshold. This targets the listed demand-forecast-error unknowns with biases 0.065–0.081 and the mismatch-only rows while preserving supplier-delay priority; v1 had accuracy 0.708 and 23 unknowns.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
